design_analysis.brand_identity: Prestigious Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) regional development, engineering, and industrial investment holding. Clean architectural layout with high-contrast corporate navy, warm desert gold accents, crisp typography, and spacious grid hierarchy.

colors.name: primary-dark

sections.name: Corporate Header & Navigation
sections.description: Sticky top bar with RDGCC logo, language switcher (EN/AR), corporate navigation menu, and inquiry CTA.

sections.name: Strategic Vision Hero
sections.description: Hero banner showcasing regional investment mission, strategic headlines, primary & secondary action buttons.

sections.name: About RDGCC & Executive Vision
sections.description: Two-column strategic narrative detailing GCC expansion, historical legacy, and values.

sections.name: Strategic Business Sectors
sections.description: Interactive 4-card sector grid: Energy & Industrial, Maritime Logistics, Infrastructure & Real Estate, Sustainable Technology.

sections.name: Key Performance Indicators
sections.description: 4-column metric counters highlighting portfolio value, regional hubs, operational years, and compliance score.

sections.name: Featured Strategic Projects
sections.description: Card gallery showcasing flagship GCC developments with category tags and overview metrics.

sections.name: Regional Presence & Inquiry
sections.description: Corporate contact form with sector inquiry dropdown and regional headquarters directory.

sections.name: Corporate Footer
sections.description: Multi-column directory with legal disclaimers, Sanity-ready structured links, and copyright.
